blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Том другое ___ (запеть, pf., fut. 3rd sg.), когда узнает, что ему уготовлено.
exercises.prompt: Tom will change his tune when he finds out what's in store for him.
exercises.why: **запеть → запоёт** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Вам ___ (прийтись, pf., fut. 3rd sg.) копнуть поглубже, если хотите дойти до правды.
exercises.prompt: You're going to have to delve deeper if you want to get to the truth.
exercises.why: **прийтись → придётся** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Давай ___ (присесть, pf., fut. 1st pl.) на лавочку.
exercises.prompt: Let's sit down on the bench.
exercises.why: **присесть → присядем** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future. Давай — one person (ты); Давайте — several people, or one person by вы; the verb is the same.

exercises.q: Овёс не ___ (созреть, pf., fut. 3rd sg.) вперёд ячменя.
exercises.prompt: Oats do not ripen before barley.
exercises.why: **созреть → созреет** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Будем надеяться, здравый смысл ___ (возобладать, pf., fut. 3rd sg.).
exercises.prompt: Hopefully, common sense will prevail.
exercises.why: **возобладать → возобладает** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: ___ (закруглить, pf., imper. pl.) слегка края.
exercises.prompt: Round off the edges a little.
exercises.why: **закруглить → Закруглите** — perfective verb, 2nd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Я ___ (измерить, pf., fut. 1st sg.) вам давление.
exercises.prompt: I'm going to take your blood pressure.
exercises.why: **измерить → измерю** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Диме безразлично, ___ (выполнить, pf., fut. 3rd sg.) он работу или нет.
exercises.prompt: Dima doesn't care whether he accomplish the job or not.
exercises.why: **выполнить → выполнит** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Мэри ___ (закатить, pf., fut. 3rd sg.) истерику, когда узнает об этом.
exercises.prompt: When Mary finds out about it she'll throw a fit.
exercises.why: **закатить → закатит** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Том вряд ли ___ (проиграть, pf., fut. 3rd sg.).
exercises.prompt: Tom isn't likely to lose.
exercises.why: **проиграть → проиграет** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Я вам глаза ___ (выцарапать, pf., fut. 1st sg.)!
exercises.prompt: I'll gouge out your eyes!
exercises.why: **выцарапать → выцарапаю** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Эта книга ___ (преобразить, pf., fut. 3rd sg.) вашу жизнь.
exercises.prompt: This book will transform your life.
exercises.why: **преобразить → преобразит** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Книжный магазин в таком месте не ___ (окупить, pf., fut. 3rd sg.) свою работу.
exercises.prompt: A bookstore in that location wouldn't make enough money to survive.
exercises.why: **окупить → окупит** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Я потом подробнее ___ (объяснить, pf., fut. 1st sg.).
exercises.prompt: I'll explain it in more detail later.
exercises.why: **объяснить → объясню** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Драка ничего не ___ (решить, pf., fut. 3rd sg.).
exercises.prompt: Fighting won't settle anything.
exercises.why: **решить → решит** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Процентные ставки ___ (повыситься, pf., fut. 3rd pl.) из-за ужесточения монетарной политики.
exercises.prompt: Interest rates will rise due to monetary tightening.
exercises.why: **повыситься → повысятся** — perfective verb, 3rd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: От работы кони ___ (дохнуть, pf., fut. 3rd pl.).
exercises.prompt: All work and no play makes Johnny a dull boy.
exercises.why: **дохнуть → дохнут** — present-type form, 3rd person plural: ending -ут belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Сколько времени ты ___ (пробыть, pf., fut. 2nd sg.) в Оксфорде?
exercises.prompt: How long are you going to stay in Oxford?
exercises.why: **пробыть → пробудешь** — perfective verb, 2nd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Давай бутылочку вина ___ (раздавить, pf., fut. 1st pl.).
exercises.prompt: Let's split a bottle of wine.
exercises.why: **раздавить → раздавим** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future. Давай — one person (ты); Давайте — several people, or one person by вы; the verb is the same.

exercises.q: Мотовство до добра не ___ (довести, pf., fut. 3rd sg.).
exercises.prompt: Waste not, want not.
exercises.why: **довести → доведёт** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
